Nice cleanup — 2 200+ lines of dead code gone, DI graph slimmed, and the surviving Safe balances path is still fully covered. A few small follow-ups you might want to consider:

### 1. `safeAddress` param on `IBalancesApiManager.getApi` is now dead
`src/domain/interfaces/balances-api.manager.interface.ts:19` still declares `safeAddress` as required, and the impl renames it to `_safeAddress` (`balances-api.manager.ts:43`). Every caller (`balances.repository.ts:28/44/56`, `collectibles.repository.ts:26/38`, `hooks-cache.integration.spec.ts:1352/1357`, `balances-api.manager.spec.ts:84/141`) still generates a fake address just to satisfy the signature. Since the branching that used it is gone, consider dropping the parameter from the interface and its call sites — makes the contract match reality and removes noise from the tests.

### 2. Dead `features.counterfactualBalances` feature flag
The only consumer of `features.counterfactualBalances` (`configuration.ts:420-421`, `FF_COUNTERFACTUAL_BALANCES`) was `BalancesApiManager`, which no longer reads it. The env var, its `.env.sample.json` entry, the `.vscode/launch.json` override, and the `counterfactualBalances: true/false` toggles in `balances.controller.integration.spec.ts:38`, `collectibles.controller.integration.spec.ts:43`, `safes.controller.overview.integration.spec.ts:48`, and `safes.v2.controller.overview.integration.spec.ts:50/410` can all be removed. Leaving it behind will confuse future readers into thinking there's still a counterfactual code path. [Fix this →](https://claude.ai/code?q=Remove%20the%20now-dead%20features.counterfactualBalances%20flag%20on%20branch%20wa-2753-remove-zerion-from-balances-endpoint%20of%20safe-global%2Fsafe-client-gateway.%20Its%20only%20consumer%20was%20BalancesApiManager%2C%20which%20no%20longer%20reads%20it.%20Drop%3A%20the%20env%20var%20definition%20in%20src%2Fconfig%2Fentities%2Fconfiguration.ts%3A420-421%2C%20the%20FF_COUNTERFACTUAL_BALANCES%20entry%20in%20.env.sample.json%3A639%2C%20the%20.vscode%2Flaunch.json%3A18%20override%2C%20the%20default%20in%20src%2Fconfig%2Fentities%2F__tests__%2Fconfiguration.ts%3A213%2C%20and%20the%20counterfactualBalances%3A%20true%2Ffalse%20overrides%20in%20balances.controller.integration.spec.ts%2C%20collectibles.controller.integration.spec.ts%2C%20safes.controller.overview.integration.spec.ts%2C%20and%20safes.v2.controller.overview.integration.spec.ts.&repo=safe-global/safe-client-gateway)

### 3. Redundant `rawify` in `getFiatCodes`
`balances-api.manager.ts:47-49`:
```ts
async getFiatCodes(): Promise<Raw<Array<string>>> {
  return rawify(await this.coingeckoApi.getFiatCodes());
}
```
`IPricesApi.getFiatCodes()` already returns `Raw<Array<string>>` (`prices-api.interface.ts:19`), so `rawify` is a no-op cast here. Simplify to:
```ts
getFiatCodes(): Promise<Raw<Array<string>>> {
  return this.coingeckoApi.getFiatCodes();
}
```

### 4. No test for the new counterfactual → 404 behavior
The PR body highlights that "Counterfactual safes now return a 404 from `/balances`," but the integration suite (`balances.controller.integration.spec.ts`) doesn't assert this new behavior. It's low risk (the tx service naturally 404s), but since this is an intentional user-visible change, one small test — tx service returns 404 for `/api/v1/safes/{address}/balances/` → controller returns 404 — would lock it in and document the intent.

### Nits (optional)
- `balances-api.manager.spec.ts` no longer needs any `safeAddress`-branch coverage, but the two remaining `getApi` tests still generate `safeAddress`. Ties into point 1.
- The old `Balances API Manager Tests > getApi checks` describe block could be renamed to something like `SafeBalancesApi routing` since Zerion is no longer part of the routing decision.

Nothing blocking — code quality, correctness, and test coverage for the retained path all look solid.
